reason: A browser-side DSH plugin that provides terminal-style recall and navigation of previously sent messages in the current conversation using Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框中使用 Ctrl+Up 和 Ctrl+Down 召回并切换当前会话中已发送的消息。
summaries.en: Recall and navigate previously sent messages in the current DSH Web conversation with Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down.

capabilities: Intercepts Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down in the conversation input
Reads user messages from the current conversation snapshot
Updates the conversation draft through the official input interface
